Name: Expensive Turtle to Salamander
Author: jackolidus
Description:
This mod turns the expensive turtle pet into a salamander. For my boyfriend.

I have not yet changed the icon in Marnie's store or the name of the animal when you click on it (still says turtle), but once I figure out how to change those, I will update!

Downloads.Description: Turns the expensive turtle into a spotted salamander.
